name: The Living Screen
description: The numbers live in the cards of a working interface rebuilt in 3D; the camera locks onto the card he names, close enough to read, then pulls back.

rated.words: They're all approved. I don't actually think these are the problem. I think how we integrate title cards and real-world images and motion animation is the issue.
